drafts.content: {"type":"doc","content":[{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Dear Selection Committee,"}]},{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I am writing to apply for the Helios Research Fellowship in Computational Biology, and to propose work on interpretable single-cell models for host–pathogen response. I am a second-year Master’s student in Computational Biology and Bioinformatics at the University of Bab Ezzouar."}]},{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"My thesis centres on single-cell RNA-seq analysis for immune response modelling. I built a reproducible Nextflow and Python pipeline that processes roughly 12,000 cells per run, cutting the analysis stage from eleven hours to under two, and I presented the results at a national conference last spring."}]},{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"A twelve-month placement in a computational genomics group is the clearest next step for me: I would bring a working knowledge of PyTorch, R and single-cell pipelines, and I would gain the laboratory methods I currently lack."}]},{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I have attached a two-page proposal outlining a first-year project on batch correction across tissues, and I would be glad to discuss it further."}]},{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Sincerely, Sara Benali"}]}]}
